Property.Name: AutoNumberRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is used to define the numbering rule for Slit Containers.

Property.Name: ReduceQty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides way to reduce qty and qty2 from the parent container. The default value for this field will be true. If this field set to false, the Qty and Qty2 for the parent container will not be reduce after split.

Property.Name: SlitCount
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Number of rows to be split against the parent container in Slitting transaction.

Property.Name: SlitProduct
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Product that going to be assigned to the Slit Containers.

Property.Name: AllowZeroQtys
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn on (AllowZeroQtys is False) the validations that Qty have to be greater than Zero.

Property.Name: AutoNumber
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic Boolean

Property.Name: ChildContainers
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of containers to be moved to the ToContainer

Property.Name: CloseWhenEmpty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: If set to True, the FromContainer will be closed when the quantity reaches zero.

Property.Name: Documents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A Document Entry is used to include a Document in a Document and provide a description for it within the Document Set. If there is more than one Document within a Document Set when a request is made to display a Document Set, the list of Document Entries is used to build a selection list. (Note that a one-to-one relationship between a Document Set and a Document is likely the common scenario).

Property.Name: EnableRPT
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A flag to determine whether the service will trigger the RPT calculation.

Property.Name: RemainingProcessTime
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

Property.Name: ToContainerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the container to hold the split off containers/material.

Property.Name: CalledByTransactionTask
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: If this transaction is being performed as part of an e-procedure, this is the TransactionTask where it was specified.

Property.Name: Carrier
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Container
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Container against which the service is being performed. A container is a tracking mechanism used for WIP material processed in the factory.

Property.Name: DataCollectionDef
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData. If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically. If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using. For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes. When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.

Property.Name: DataCollectionDefs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Once the Container is set, this list field is populated with all DataCollectionDef entries matching current service in the Container.Spec.TxnMap. This allows the provision of SelectionValues for ContainerTxn.DataCollectionDef field so that user can manually resolve the possible DataCollectionDef ambiguity.

Property.Name: DispatchItem
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Facilitates the configuration of dispatching rules for MfgOrders and Containers on Shopfloor services. Only one entry per dispatch item type will be allowed to be configured.

Property.Name: DispatchRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field represents the existence of an order dispatch type within the dispatch rule, used in the enforcement of the Dispatch Rule.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The signature requirement for the spec/service combination. Only one should be defined for the combination.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: IsConfirmation
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is flag means that this transaction will execute with confirmation

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgCalendar
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

Property.Name: MfgOrder
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system.
A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Operation
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The operation at which the work was performed. If required, this field is meant to be used as an edit check to reduce the possibility that a user entered the wrong container name.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: PrintQueue
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

Property.Name: ProcessActiveMfgOrder
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is a flag to enable the processing of active mfg orders, which will validate the resources' active mfg orders with the process container mfg orders.

Property.Name: ProcessESignatures
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service. This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).

Property.Name: ProcessResourceStatusModel
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Flag used to find and execute a StatusModelDetail with a PreconditionToAutoSet that returns true.

Property.Name: ResourceLastRouteStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

Property.Name: SamplingPlan
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product. The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

Property.Name: TaskContainer
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: If this service is being performed as part of a e-procedure task, this is the container for which the e-procedure is being processed. This field is used top populate the ExecuteTaskService.Container field, and for ContainerTxns, this will be the same as the Container field. It is needed for the case where the service is not a Container Transaction, e.g. ResourceSetup.

Property.Name: UpdateThruputOnChildRes
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Update Thruput Qty on Child Resources

Property.Name: UseDispatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configures a service to be enabled for using the dispatch functionality

Property.Name: UseMfgNCR
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Use Mfg NCR

Property.Name: UseQueue
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Defines the usage of queue at this operation. If a queue is required, a transaction (MoveIn) must be performed prior to any work being recorded.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: WorkCenter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed. A work Center contains zero or more operations.
The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources. A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

Property.Name: ActionSource
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to filter Actions.

Property.Name: AdditionalESigReqs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of ESignature Requirements that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: AlertMsgList
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A string list used holds the additional messages of a transaction

Property.Name: AlertMsgListDelimiter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A string field used to define the delimiter string to separate the additional messages

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: EmailGroup
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Fields that can be used to identify the EmailGroup to send an email to. Some transactions allow the user to set the EmailGroup to send to such as LotHold and LotRelease.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: EnforceDispatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean flag to override dispatch enforcement.

Property.Name: HasDataCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Returns true if the associated service has a data collection assigned, false otherwise.

Property.Name: HasDPCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine if the data collection type is of type DataPointCollection.

Property.Name: HasUserDataCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine the type of data collection to process, UserDataCollection or ParametricDataCollection.

Property.Name: IsExternalAppTxnExecution
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

Property.Name: ParametricDataControl
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: FileName - used for fields that specify files.

Property.Name: ParametricDataDefType
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CDO Definition Id

Property.Name: PrintingResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Printing Result

Property.Name: PrintLabels
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic Boolean

Property.Name: ProcessEProcedures
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessMaintMgmt
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessMasterRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Master Recipe processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessNCRs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the NCRs processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessTrainingReqs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place. Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

Property.Name: SampleQty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Sample Qty

Property.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test.. For each Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured. Resolved from the Container

Property.Name: SpecFilter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is getting from Line Assignment and its meant to be used as a filter parameter for shopfloor queries.

Property.Name: ss_SPCRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

Property.Name: TaskTime
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Time it took to perform the task

Property.Name: TrainingRequirements
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: TxnParentServiceName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the parent service that calls a subservice.

Property.Name: TxnServiceSequence
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.

Property.Name: WebPart
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique name for this instance

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: CurrentDay
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CurrentMonth
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CurrentWeekOfYear
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds the current week of the year (1-52)

Property.Name: CurrentYear
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: SmartBarcode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Barcode to be parsed using a Smart Scan Rule

Property.Name: SmartScanParseError
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Smart parsing from CLF will not throw an error. If any error does occur, a message will be output here. The calling CLF can decide what to do with it.

Property.Name: SmartScanRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Rule to use for parsing Smart Barcode

Property.Name: StrSplitResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Utility field to hold results of string split.

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.Name: InstanceID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.

NavigationProperty.Name: ToContainerDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: System field used to generate history for the service. The user should not set this field.

NavigationProperty.Name: CollectDataPoints
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The Collect Data Points transaction is used to collect data points for a trackable object. It requires that the trackable object have a DataPointCollection assigned to it.

NavigationProperty.Name: CurrentContainerStatus
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Current status information of a Container

NavigationProperty.Name: ESigProcessTimerDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement for Process Timer

NavigationProperty.Name: LiveRelayInfo
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: LiveRelayInfo. Contains all of the information to perform the Remote Service and Response. It is primarily used for communication between InSite sites: for instance when containers are shipped.

NavigationProperty.Name: WIPMsgMgr
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: WIP Message Manager. Provides functions for retrieval, acknowledgement and writing to history of WIP messages.

NavigationProperty.Name: ActionDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: List of actions. It's built based on the ActionType field.

NavigationProperty.Name: ComputationDetail
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Details of the Computation

NavigationProperty.Name: ESigDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement.

NavigationProperty.Name: LabelSummaries
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: When printing labels, the information needed to print as well as the values (details) are resolved and kept here for use later.

NavigationProperty.Name: ParametricData
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: This object holds the parametric data fields (measurements, etc.) that need to be collected for this service. The service determines what parametric data are needed by looking in the Transaction Map of the Spec.

NavigationProperty.Name: SmartScanParseResults
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds result of parsing one data value from the Smart Barcode

Property.Name: Carrier
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

Property.Name: CloseWhenZero
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is used to specify whether or not a container will be closed if the container qty is zero after the execution of the transaction. A "true" value (checked) indicates that the status of the container will be set to 2 (= closed) following the change quantity transaction.

Property.Name: Container
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Container against which the service is being performed. A container is a tracking mechanism used for WIP material processed in the factory.

Property.Name: LossReason
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user code for loss reason.

Property.Name: DisassociateWhenClosed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is used to specify whether or not a container will be disassociated when it is closed. See also "CloseWhenZero" field.

Property.Name: EnableRPT
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A flag to determine whether the service will trigger the RPT calculation.

Property.Name: GenerateRollups
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Determines whether rollup records have to be generated. Rollups are summaries for intermediate and top-level containers concerning how much quantity was changed for all the containers underneath them with this transaction.

Property.Name: ProcessESignatures
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service. This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).

Property.Name: RecordAllQtySummaryOnly
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When using the RecordAllQty function, this flag indicates whether to write history details for each of the child containers or whether a single summary record is written.

Property.Name: RemainingProcessTime
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

Property.Name: Resource
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user may use this field to assign a resource at which the change quantity may be attributed to (Example: Scrap due to equipment failure). A resource is defined as a non-WIP entity which needs to be tracked/measured, such as a machine, person or storage location.

Property.Name: RollupReason
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The reason for generating the rollup records.

Property.Name: ThruputReportingLevel
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Container Level at which to adjust thruput, to account for quantity changes that happened before processing versus after processing. For correct functioning, must match the ThruputReportingLevel used by the Thruput transaction. Typically this field gets its value from a CVE that looks up the ThruputReportingLevel from the operation, and users are not allowed to update this field.

Property.Name: ThruputSummary
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Determines whether to adjust the thruput qtys of the top-level container if necessary, to account for quantity changes that happened before processing versus after processing. For correct functioning, must match the value used by the Thruput transaction. Typically users are not allowed to update this field.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Fields that can be used to identify the EmailGroup to send an email to. Some transactions allow the user to set the EmailGroup to send to such as LotHold and LotRelease.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: EnforceDispatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean flag to override dispatch enforcement.

Property.Name: HasDataCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Returns true if the associated service has a data collection assigned, false otherwise.

Property.Name: HasDPCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine if the data collection type is of type DataPointCollection.

Property.Name: HasUserDataCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine the type of data collection to process, UserDataCollection or ParametricDataCollection.

Property.Name: IsExternalAppTxnExecution
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

Property.Name: ParametricDataControl
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: FileName - used for fields that specify files.

Property.Name: ParametricDataDefType
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CDO Definition Id

Property.Name: PrintingResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Printing Result

Property.Name: PrintLabels
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic Boolean

Property.Name: ProcessEProcedures
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessMaintMgmt
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessMasterRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Master Recipe processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessNCRs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the NCRs processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessTrainingReqs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place. Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

Property.Name: SampleQty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Sample Qty

Property.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test.. For each Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured. Resolved from the Container

Property.Name: SpecFilter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is getting from Line Assignment and its meant to be used as a filter parameter for shopfloor queries.

Property.Name: ss_SPCRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

Property.Name: TaskTime
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Time it took to perform the task

Property.Name: TrainingRequirements
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: TxnParentServiceName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the parent service that calls a subservice.

Property.Name: TxnServiceSequence
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.

Property.Name: WebPart
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique name for this instance

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: CurrentDay
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CurrentMonth
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CurrentWeekOfYear
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds the current week of the year (1-52)

Property.Name: CurrentYear
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: SmartBarcode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Barcode to be parsed using a Smart Scan Rule

Property.Name: SmartScanParseError
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Smart parsing from CLF will not throw an error. If any error does occur, a message will be output here. The calling CLF can decide what to do with it.

Property.Name: SmartScanRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Rule to use for parsing Smart Barcode

Property.Name: StrSplitResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Utility field to hold results of string split.

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.Name: InstanceID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.

NavigationProperty.Name: ServiceDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The individual items a user inputs to specifically explain why the quantity is being changed.

NavigationProperty.Name: CollectDataPoints
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The Collect Data Points transaction is used to collect data points for a trackable object. It requires that the trackable object have a DataPointCollection assigned to it.

NavigationProperty.Name: CurrentContainerStatus
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Current status information of a Container

NavigationProperty.Name: ESigProcessTimerDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement for Process Timer

NavigationProperty.Name: LiveRelayInfo
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: LiveRelayInfo. Contains all of the information to perform the Remote Service and Response. It is primarily used for communication between InSite sites: for instance when containers are shipped.

NavigationProperty.Name: WIPMsgMgr
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: WIP Message Manager. Provides functions for retrieval, acknowledgement and writing to history of WIP messages.

NavigationProperty.Name: ActionDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: List of actions. It's built based on the ActionType field.

NavigationProperty.Name: ComputationDetail
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Details of the Computation

NavigationProperty.Name: ESigDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement.

NavigationProperty.Name: LabelSummaries
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: When printing labels, the information needed to print as well as the values (details) are resolved and kept here for use later.

NavigationProperty.Name: ParametricData
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: This object holds the parametric data fields (measurements, etc.) that need to be collected for this service. The service determines what parametric data are needed by looking in the Transaction Map of the Spec.

NavigationProperty.Name: SmartScanParseResults
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds result of parsing one data value from the Smart Barcode

Property.Name: EnableRPT
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A flag to determine whether the service will trigger the RPT calculation.

Property.Name: Location
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is used to identify the current physical location that the Container is being moved from. Locations define physical areas within a Factory. This can be as high level as a single Location that defines the entire Factory or as specific as individual Locations for each bin within a holding area. Every Container includes a Location attribute.

Property.Name: Path
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A Path defines an allowable (Standard) move from one Step to another within a Workflow. If a path is entered here, this path will override any information entered on the "Step" field. If no path or step is provided, pathselectors for the step will be evaluated to determine which path will be used. If no path selectors are valid, the container will be moved to the step referenced by the default path in the workflow.

Property.Name: RemainingProcessTime
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

Property.Name: Resource
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This object indicates which resource was used to process the container. A resource is defined as a non-WIP entity which needs to be tracked/measured, such as a machine, person or storage location.

Property.Name: ToStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This object refers to the Workflow Step where the container is being moved to. If a path is provided, the path will override any information entered here. If no path or step is provided, pathselectors for the step will be evaluated to determine which path will be used. If no path selectors are valid, the container will be moved to the step referenced by the default path in the workflow.

Property.Name: ChildCount
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This indicates the number of direct child containers associated to the parent container. This field is used for qty balancing in V1.4, when compound transactions link a move with ChangeQty.

Property.Name: ClearToWorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag is used when the ToWorkflowStack list field is meant to be cleared.

Property.Name: Close
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is used to specify whether or not a container will be closed after the execution of the transaction. A "true" value (checked) indicates that the status of the container will be set to 2 (= closed) following the move transaction. An example of when a container is closed, is when the container is shipped to the customer/distributor.

Property.Name: Container
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Container against which the service is being performed. A container is a tracking mechanism used for WIP material processed in the factory.

Property.Name: EquipmentCycleTimeMS
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Equipment cycle time in milliseconds.

Property.Name: IPLTimeDone
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The done time value to transmit to the IPL system. Example output format is as follows: '2019-07-07T10:00:07.1035578+03:00'

Property.Name: MoveAllQty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to indicate whether or not entire quantity of the container will be moved to the next operation. A "true" value (checked) indicates that the entire quantity of the container will be moved. A value of "false" only makes sense in the context of a compound transaction, where the user must specify the quantity to be moved, and must account for the differences using the ChangeQty service. (Available in V1.4).

Property.Name: NavigationMode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Workflow navigation mode determines whether to use a regular Path or a ReworkPath during Move transactions. Possible navigational modes are: Standard = 1 Rework = 2

Property.Name: OverrideCurrentStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The intent of this field is to enable the client application to override the current status of the container (the step where the container is located at the beginning of the transaction). If the client application sets this field to "True" the transaction will assume the container is at the operation/step the client specifies, instead of using the operation/step of the container. This field should only be used for advanced automation systems where there is a virtual certainty that the automation system holds the correct information about the current location of the container. This allows the automation system to perform moves easily after the InSite has been taken offline and brought back up for database maintenance, etc. Note that there are no history records generated for the moves "missed".

Property.Name: ProcessActiveMfgOrder
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is a flag to enable the processing of active mfg orders, which will validate the resources' active mfg orders with the process container mfg orders.

Property.Name: Qty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A quantity of material being tracked within a container. Each quantity has a corresponding unit of measure.

Property.Name: Qty2
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A quantity of material being tracked within a container. Each quantity has a corresponding unit of measure. This field is only used if 2 units of measure need to be tracked at once. For instance, when specifying a container one might need to record both length and weight as quantities.

Property.Name: ResourceLastProcessedContainer
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The last container that was processed via the selected resource from a move or movein operation.

Property.Name: Spec
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This spec is used by the OverrideCurrentStatus function.

Property.Name: Step
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This object refers to the Workflow Step where the container is currently at and being moved from.

Property.Name: ToFactory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is used to identify the factory that the container is being moved to. Used by "Ship" transactions.

Property.Name: ToLocation
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is used to identify the physical location that the Container is being moved to. Locations define physical areas within a Factory. This can be as high level as a single Location that defines the entire Factory or as specific as individual Locations for each bin within a holding area. Every Container includes a Location attribute.

Property.Name: ToResource
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field indicates which resource the container is being moved to. A resource is defined as a non-WIP entity which needs to be tracked/measured, such as a machine, person or storage location.

Property.Name: ToSpecStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Steps are used to discretely define processing for a point (step) within a Workflow. A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are related using Paths. Each Step contains zero or more Paths, which link to another Step. One Path at each Step is identified as the default Path.
A sequence of Steps and Paths is a Route. A Workflow can include multiple Routes. Only one Route is identified as the Standard Route. The Standard Route is determined by starting with the Step that is identified as the first Step and then iterating forward selecting the default path at each step.
A Specification Step is a step within a Workflow that includes a reference to a Spec which in turn describes the work that is to be performed.

Property.Name: ToWorkflow
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The workflow containing the ToStep to move to

Property.Name: ToWorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the stack of subworkflow steps that lead to the current spec step.

Property.Name: TrackStepPass
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A Boolean flag to indicate whether to track the Step Pass for the Containers.

Property.Name: UnitCount
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the number of unit containers within the container structure. This field is used for qty balancing in V1.4, when compound transactions link a move with ChangeQty.

Property.Name: UseDispatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configures a service to be enabled for using the dispatch functionality

Property.Name: WorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the stack of subworkflow steps that lead to the current spec step.

Property.Name: CalledByTransactionTask
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: If this transaction is being performed as part of an e-procedure, this is the TransactionTask where it was specified.

Property.Name: Carrier
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: DataCollectionDef
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData. If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically. If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using. For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes. When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.

Property.Name: DataCollectionDefs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Once the Container is set, this list field is populated with all DataCollectionDef entries matching current service in the Container.Spec.TxnMap. This allows the provision of SelectionValues for ContainerTxn.DataCollectionDef field so that user can manually resolve the possible DataCollectionDef ambiguity.

Property.Name: DispatchItem
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Facilitates the configuration of dispatching rules for MfgOrders and Containers on Shopfloor services. Only one entry per dispatch item type will be allowed to be configured.

Property.Name: DispatchRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field represents the existence of an order dispatch type within the dispatch rule, used in the enforcement of the Dispatch Rule.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The signature requirement for the spec/service combination. Only one should be defined for the combination.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: IsConfirmation
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is flag means that this transaction will execute with confirmation

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgCalendar
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

Property.Name: MfgOrder
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system.
A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Operation
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The operation at which the work was performed. If required, this field is meant to be used as an edit check to reduce the possibility that a user entered the wrong container name.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: PrintQueue
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

Property.Name: ProcessESignatures
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service. This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).

Property.Name: ProcessResourceStatusModel
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Flag used to find and execute a StatusModelDetail with a PreconditionToAutoSet that returns true.

Property.Name: ResourceLastRouteStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

Property.Name: SamplingPlan
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product. The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

Property.Name: TaskContainer
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: If this service is being performed as part of a e-procedure task, this is the container for which the e-procedure is being processed. This field is used top populate the ExecuteTaskService.Container field, and for ContainerTxns, this will be the same as the Container field. It is needed for the case where the service is not a Container Transaction, e.g. ResourceSetup.

Property.Name: UpdateThruputOnChildRes
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Update Thruput Qty on Child Resources

Property.Name: UseMfgNCR
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Use Mfg NCR

Property.Name: UseQueue
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Defines the usage of queue at this operation. If a queue is required, a transaction (MoveIn) must be performed prior to any work being recorded.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: WorkCenter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed. A work Center contains zero or more operations.
The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources. A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

Property.Name: ActionSource
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to filter Actions.

Property.Name: AdditionalESigReqs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of ESignature Requirements that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: AlertMsgList
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A string list used holds the additional messages of a transaction

Property.Name: AlertMsgListDelimiter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A string field used to define the delimiter string to separate the additional messages

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: EmailGroup
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Fields that can be used to identify the EmailGroup to send an email to. Some transactions allow the user to set the EmailGroup to send to such as LotHold and LotRelease.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: EnforceDispatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean flag to override dispatch enforcement.

Property.Name: HasDataCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Returns true if the associated service has a data collection assigned, false otherwise.

Property.Name: HasDPCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine if the data collection type is of type DataPointCollection.

Property.Name: HasUserDataCollection
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine the type of data collection to process, UserDataCollection or ParametricDataCollection.

Property.Name: IsExternalAppTxnExecution
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

Property.Name: ParametricDataControl
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: FileName - used for fields that specify files.

Property.Name: ParametricDataDefType
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CDO Definition Id

Property.Name: PrintingResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Printing Result

Property.Name: PrintLabels
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic Boolean

Property.Name: ProcessEProcedures
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessMaintMgmt
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessMasterRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Master Recipe processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessNCRs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the NCRs processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Property.Name: ProcessTrainingReqs
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place. Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

Property.Name: SampleQty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Sample Qty

Property.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test.. For each Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured. Resolved from the Container

Property.Name: SpecFilter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is getting from Line Assignment and its meant to be used as a filter parameter for shopfloor queries.

Property.Name: ss_SPCRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

Property.Name: TaskTime
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Time it took to perform the task

Property.Name: TrainingRequirements
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: TxnParentServiceName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the parent service that calls a subservice.

Property.Name: TxnServiceSequence
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.

Property.Name: WebPart
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique name for this instance

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: CurrentDay
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CurrentMonth
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CurrentWeekOfYear
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds the current week of the year (1-52)

Property.Name: CurrentYear
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: SmartBarcode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Barcode to be parsed using a Smart Scan Rule

Property.Name: SmartScanParseError
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Smart parsing from CLF will not throw an error. If any error does occur, a message will be output here. The calling CLF can decide what to do with it.

Property.Name: SmartScanRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Rule to use for parsing Smart Barcode

Property.Name: StrSplitResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Utility field to hold results of string split.

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.Name: InstanceID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.

NavigationProperty.Name: CloseContainer
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Sets the container's status from active to close

NavigationProperty.Name: DisassociateChildrens
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Is used to disassociate children containers

NavigationProperty.Name: Hold
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Is a service used to put the container and its ancestors on hold. Held Containers cannot undergo normal processing (such transactions as MoveIn, Thruput, ChangeQty, Move, etc.). Transaction that can occur on held containers include to release, collect data, split, disassociate, and change attribute.

NavigationProperty.Name: HVComponentIssue
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Associates a Container with an HVSetup defined on a Resource. This provides a level of traceability while minimizing history records.

NavigationProperty.Name: LiveRelayInfo
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: LiveRelayInfo. Contains all of the information to perform the Remote Service and Response. It is primarily used for communication between InSite sites: for instance when containers are shipped.

NavigationProperty.Name: CollectDataPoints
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The Collect Data Points transaction is used to collect data points for a trackable object. It requires that the trackable object have a DataPointCollection assigned to it.

NavigationProperty.Name: CurrentContainerStatus
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Current status information of a Container

NavigationProperty.Name: ESigProcessTimerDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement for Process Timer

NavigationProperty.Name: WIPMsgMgr
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: WIP Message Manager. Provides functions for retrieval, acknowledgement and writing to history of WIP messages.

NavigationProperty.Name: ActionDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: List of actions. It's built based on the ActionType field.

NavigationProperty.Name: ComputationDetail
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Details of the Computation

NavigationProperty.Name: ESigDetails
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement.

NavigationProperty.Name: LabelSummaries
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: When printing labels, the information needed to print as well as the values (details) are resolved and kept here for use later.

NavigationProperty.Name: ParametricData
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: This object holds the parametric data fields (measurements, etc.) that need to be collected for this service. The service determines what parametric data are needed by looking in the Transaction Map of the Spec.

NavigationProperty.Name: SmartScanParseResults
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds result of parsing one data value from the Smart Barcode
